label: ecu_communication_lost
note: The ECU stopped answering while the adapter link was up. This is NOT proof that the ignition was switched off. Vehicle polling is paused (sleeping modules are not polled or woken); only the adapter supply voltage is read. The engine was last seen RUNNING; an engine stop was not observed.
